goal: Iske baad aap strings ko edit aur search kar sakte hain (append, substr, find, insert, erase, replace), strings compare kar sakte hain, text aur numbers ke darmiyan convert kar sakte hain, <cctype> ke functions use kar sakte hain, aur chhote programs likh sakte hain jaise vowels ginna, string ko ulta karna aur palindrome check karna.
warmup: Apne WhatsApp ke naam ya kisi message ke bare mein sochein jo aap type karte hain: aap aakhir mein ek lafz jorte hain, ghalti mita dete hain, lambi chat mein kisi lafz ko search karte hain, "Hello" ko "Salam" bana dete hain, ya check karte hain ke do naam ek jaise hain ya nahi. C++ ki string yeh sab kaam ek tayyar function se kar sakti hai.
definition: std::string class ke saath member functions aate hain. Member function ko string ke baad dot laga kar call karte hain: s.length(). Positions ko index kehte hain aur 0 se shuru hoti hain. find match ka index deta hai, ya khaas value string::npos ("no position") deta hai jab kuch match na ho. Header <cctype> aise simple functions deta hai jo EK character par kaam karte hain: isalpha, isdigit, toupper, tolower. stoi aur to_string functions text aur numbers ke darmiyan convert karte hain.
howItWorks: Pehli example ka trace follow karein aur dekhein ke s kaise badalti hai. append(text) aakhir mein jorta hai aur push_back(ch) ek character jorta hai. substr(start, count) ek tukre ki COPY deta hai; original nahi badalta. find(text) pehle match ka index deta hai. Jawab use karne se pehle HAMESHA string::npos se compare karein: if (s.find("x") != string::npos) ka matlab hai mil gaya. insert(index, text) us index se pehle text rakhta hai. erase(index, count) characters hata deta hai. replace(index, count, text) ek hisse ko naye text se badal deta hai. empty() us string ke liye true hota hai jis mein koi character na ho. COMPARE KARNA: aap strings par seedha ==, !=, <, >, <=, >= use kar sakte hain. Yeh harf ba harf ASCII code se compare karte hain, is liye "apple" < "banana", aur "Zebra" < "apple" kyunke capital letters ke codes chhote letters se kam hote hain. a.compare(b) ek negative number, 0 ya positive number deta hai (sirf iski sign par bharosa karein). CHARACTER FUNCTIONS (<cctype>): isalpha(c), isdigit(c), toupper(c), tolower(c). Yeh ek char par kaam karte hain, is liye inhein string par loop ke andar use karein. CONVERT KARNA: stoi("42") int 42 deta hai aur to_string(43) text "43" deta hai. stoi digits mangta hai; "abc" jaisa text convert nahi ho sakta. PATTERNS: vowels ginna (loop, tolower, a, e, i, o, u se compare); string ulta karna (nayi string banayein rev = ch + rev se, ya dono siron ke characters swap karein); palindrome (aisa lafz jo apne ulte ke barabar ho, jaise level ya Madam agar case ignore karein).
